description: Add llms.txt and llms-full.txt to aptabase.com and all SDK repos so AI coding agents can discover and integrate Aptabase SDKs

userStories.title: Create llms.txt for aptabase.com with SDK catalog
userStories.description: As an AI coding agent, I need a structured overview of Aptabase at aptabase.com/llms.txt so I can discover it as an analytics solution and identify the correct SDK for any platform.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at public/llms.txt in the aptabase-com repo
H1 heading with 'Aptabase'
Blockquote summary: privacy-first, open source, GDPR-compliant, supported platforms
Lists all 16 SDKs with package name, registry, and install command
## Documentation section with links to key docs pages in format: - [Name](URL): Description
Where .md versions of pages exist and add clarity, link to those instead of HTML (e.g. aptabase.com/docs/getting-started.md)
## SDKs section with links to each SDK GitHub repo
## Optional section with self-hosting, changelog, legal links
File follows llms.txt spec (llmstxt.org)
File is under 4KB
userStories.notes: Target repo: aptabase/aptabase-com. File goes in public/llms.txt. Astro serves public/ at URL root.

userStories.title: Create llms-full.txt with inlined SDK integration guides
userStories.description: As an AI coding agent, I need a comprehensive document at aptabase.com/llms-full.txt containing complete integration instructions for all SDKs inline, so I can integrate any SDK without fetching additional URLs.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at public/llms-full.txt in the aptabase-com repo
Same H1 and summary as llms.txt
For each of the 16 SDKs: platform name, package name, install command, initialization code, trackEvent usage with and without properties, platform-specific notes
Content sourced from each SDK's GitHub README (not invented)
File is self-contained — agent does not need to fetch any other URL
Tauri section covers both Rust and JavaScript APIs
Electron section covers main/renderer process split
React section covers Next.js App Router and Pages Router
aptabase-js section covers all 4 packages: web, react, angular, browser
userStories.notes: Target repo: aptabase/aptabase-com. Expect ~20-40KB. Source content from SDK READMEs on GitHub. Manually maintained — no auto-generation.

userStories.title: Add llms.txt link to site footer
userStories.description: As a developer browsing aptabase.com, I want to find the llms.txt file so I can point my AI coding agent to it.

userStories.title: Create llms.txt template for SDK repos
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need a standardized llms.txt template so all SDK repos have consistent, agent-friendly documentation.
acceptanceCriteria: Template markdown file created with sections: Overview, Installation, Initialization, Track Events, Track Events with Properties, Configuration, Platform Notes

userStories.title: Submit aptabase.com to llms.txt directories and listings
userStories.description: As the Aptabase team, I want to submit aptabase.com/llms.txt to llms.txt directories and listings so that agents and developers can discover Aptabase through these catalogs.
acceptanceCriteria: Submit to llms-text.com (https://www.llms-text.com/)
Submit to llmstxt.org directory if they maintain one
Search for and submit to any other active llms.txt aggregator sites
Document all submissions and their status in a comment or issue
userStories.notes: Do this after US-001 is deployed and aptabase.com/llms.txt returns 200. This is a manual task — submit via web forms or GitHub PRs depending on each directory's process.
